name: Lightning-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The bolt is at its brightest with branching forks, the clearest read of the effect.

tagline: A blue-white lightning bolt cracks down the dark and flickers.
summary: One thin electric-blue bolt runs from top to bottom of a black stage, kinking and branching as it goes. The shape keeps re-forming, brightening and thinning like a live strike.
appearance: A single jagged vertical line of cool blue-white light on a black field, thicker where it forks and hairline-thin elsewhere. A soft glow bleeds a few pixels around the core, with the rest of the frame empty.
behaviour: The bolt writhes continuously, splitting into new forks and changing thickness, while its overall brightness pulses. The path stays roughly vertical and never leaves the frame.
use_when: A dark page wants a single dramatic electric accent behind sparse content.
avoid_when: You need to fill a wide area: the bolt stays in a narrow vertical band.
customise: Hue, horizontal offset, speed, intensity and scale are the only props. The fork logic and glow falloff are fixed in the shader.
weight_why: A full-screen fragment shader with a ten-octave noise stack runs every frame.

a11y.note: Decorative and always flickering, with no reduced-motion check for users sensitive to flashes.

issues: The bolt is a narrow strip, so most of a wide stage stays empty black.
Edges of the bolt show stair-step aliasing.
polish_why: A convincing electric shape, but thin, aliased and alone in a mostly empty frame.
title: Lightning
